column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah E99007: simulasi tempur Omen Squad, Kenny menelepon Nadiya,
# lalu cincin yang tidak pernah dia berikan kepada Lentine — sampai adegan kematiannya.
# Tetap Inggris: Kenny, Lentine, Lisa, Nadiya, Nada, Omen Squad, Mangi Security,
# Griffin & Kryuger, Griffin, Type 97, HK416, Groza, Task Force DEFY, T-Doll, Doll,
# Green Zone, Yellow Zone, E.L.I.D., FABN Group, 16Lab, Lonnie, Roberti, Turul,
# Frankfurt, P.M.C., Commander, Adjutant, FAILED.
# "Brother/Big Sis/Sister" dari mulut Nadiya -> "Kak" (lebih wajar untuk sapaan keluarga).
(Green Zone, Mangi Security Omen Squad Station, Preparation Room.)
column2: (Green Zone, Stasiun Omen Squad Mangi Security, Ruang Persiapan.)

column1: Doll combat simulation, Scenario Three... Frontal assault on position. Opponent: Griffin & Kryuger codename Type 97.
column2: Simulasi tempur Doll, Skenario Tiga... Serangan frontal ke posisi. Lawan: Griffin & Kryuger kode nama Type 97.

column1: (In the simulation device, holographic particles rapidly reorganized, and a virtual image of a black-haired, twin-tailed T-Doll was generated in the center of the preparation room. Holding an assault rifle, she walked slowly with light steps towards the fully armed Omen Squad.)
column2: (Di dalam perangkat simulasi, partikel holografis menata ulang dirinya dengan cepat, dan citra virtual seorang T-Doll berambut hitam bercepol dua muncul di tengah ruang persiapan. Menggenggam senapan serbu, dia berjalan lambat dengan langkah ringan ke arah Omen Squad yang bersenjata lengkap.)

column1: (Meanwhile, Kenny and the Omen Squad, piloting the heavy power mechs newly issued by the consortium, charged with an absolute advantage in size and firepower. These individual armors, claimed to rival the combat power of T-Dolls, were highly anticipated by the consortium's higher-ups.)
column2: (Di sisi lain, Kenny dan Omen Squad, mengemudikan mech bertenaga berat yang baru dibagikan konsorsium, menerjang dengan keunggulan mutlak dalam ukuran dan daya tembak. Armor perorangan yang diklaim setara kekuatan tempur T-Doll ini sangat dinanti kalangan atas konsorsium.)

column1: (However, the calculated data of reality was cold and cruel...)
column2: (Namun data hitungan kenyataannya dingin dan kejam...)

column1: (The Doll generated by the virtual projection moved lightly in the blind spots of the mech's firepower with terrifying mobility.)
column2: (Doll hasil proyeksi virtual itu bergerak ringan di titik-titik buta daya tembak mech dengan mobilitas yang menakutkan.)

column1: (In just a few encounters, the Doll dodging and weaving through the hail of bullets easily destroyed the mech's fragile power joints with extraordinary martial skills, and the mobile armor collapsed with a crash.)
column2: (Hanya dalam beberapa benturan, Doll yang menyelip di antara hujan proyektil itu dengan mudah menghancurkan sambungan tenaga mech yang rapuh memakai kemahiran bela diri luar biasa, dan armor bergerak itu runtuh dengan dentaman.)

column1: Combat failed. Resetting—Doll confrontation simulation, scenario four, night infiltration and sneak attack. Opponent, codename HK416.
column2: Pertempuran gagal. Mengatur ulang—simulasi konfrontasi Doll, skenario empat, infiltrasi malam dan serangan diam-diam. Lawan, kode nama HK416.

column1: (Failed. Grenades exploded in the simulated darkness, and the mech's stealth coating was virtually useless.)
column2: (Gagal. Granat meledak di kegelapan simulasi, dan lapisan siluman mech itu praktis tidak berguna.)

column1: Resetting... combat target, codename Groza.
column2: Mengatur ulang... target tempur, kode nama Groza.

column1: (Failed.)
column2: (Gagal.)

column1: Opponent, Task Force DEFY... Combat objective... Protect VIP.
column2: Lawan, Task Force DEFY... Objektif tempur... Lindungi VIP.

column1: (Failed...)
column2: (Gagal...)

column1: (Still failed!)
column2: (Tetap gagal!)

column1: (On the simulation interface, the glaring red "FAILED" text popped up again and again, ruthlessly mocking the Omen squad's efforts.)
column2: (Di antarmuka simulasi, teks merah menyala "FAILED" muncul lagi dan lagi, mencemooh usaha Omen Squad tanpa ampun.)

column1: ...Continue correcting parameters...
column2: ...Lanjutkan koreksi parameternya...

column1: (Countless numerical adjustments only resulted in one suspense-free defeat after another.)
column2: (Penyesuaian angka yang tak terhitung hanya menghasilkan kekalahan tanpa kejutan satu demi satu.)

column1: Kenny, turn off the machine and let everyone rest. The brothers are almost at their limit.
column2: Kenny, matikan mesinnya dan biarkan semuanya istirahat. Anak-anak sudah hampir sampai batasnya.

column1: ...Rest.
column2: ...Istirahat.

column1: Phew... that's great...
column2: Fyuh... bagus deh...

column1: I thought you had become a Spartan instructor like Adjutant Lentine at some point.
column2: Kupikir kau entah sejak kapan sudah berubah menjadi instruktur Sparta seperti Adjutant Lentine.

column1: Lentine... she just wants to consider things thoroughly. This is her, and our, first large-scale corps operation.
column2: Lentine... dia cuma ingin memperhitungkan segalanya sampai tuntas. Ini operasi korps skala besar pertama untuk dia, dan untuk kita.

column1: She hopes that no one from the Omen squad will drop out this time.
column2: Dia berharap tidak ada satu pun anggota Omen Squad yang tumbang kali ini.

column1: Me too... I hope everyone can come back safely.
column2: Aku juga... kuharap semuanya bisa kembali dengan selamat.

column1: I know that. Adjutant Lentine took out all the high bonuses from Frankfurt and distributed them to the brothers, and also gave us people with nowhere to go a place to stay.
column2: Aku tahu itu. Adjutant Lentine mengeluarkan semua bonus besar dari Frankfurt dan membagikannya ke anak-anak, dan juga memberi kami yang tidak punya tujuan ini tempat berteduh.

column1: To be honest, we are all very grateful to her.
column2: Sejujurnya, kami semua sangat berutang terima kasih padanya.

column1: Yeah, without Adjutant Lentine and you, Kenny, us guys who were forced to retire would only be reduced to eating sand in the Yellow Zone.
column2: Iya, tanpa Adjutant Lentine dan kau, Kenny, kami yang dipaksa pensiun ini cuma bakal berakhir makan pasir di Yellow Zone.

column1: By the way, Kenny, wanna go grab a couple of drinks later?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, Kenny, nanti mau ikut minum-minum sedikit?
Aku...

column1: Ahem, have you all forgotten the alcohol ban issued by Adjutant Lentine?
column2: Ehem, kalian semua lupa larangan alkohol yang dikeluarkan Adjutant Lentine?

column1: Uh... Miss Lisa, why are you here?
column2: Eh... Miss Lisa, kenapa kau di sini?

column1: That's obviously because the Tech Department filed a protest, saying that not only are you making a racket late at night, but you also accidentally wrote off a power suit during your training.
column2: Jelas karena Departemen Teknik mengajukan protes, katanya kalian bukan cuma bikin gaduh tengah malam, tapi juga tidak sengaja menghapus satu power suit dari daftar saat latihan.

column1: Sorry, that was my mistake.
column2: Maaf, itu kesalahanku.

column1: Alright, alright, hurry up and go get some rest before this gets reported upwards.
column2: Sudah, sudah, cepat pergi istirahat sebelum ini dilaporkan ke atas.

column1: Kenny, there's an external communication request for you here.
column2: Kenny, ada permintaan komunikasi dari luar untukmu.

column1: What? External? I thought our Captain Kenny wouldn't have any normal social life other than running errands to buy cigarettes for Adjutant Lentine.
column2: Apa? Dari luar? Kupikir Kapten Kenny kita tidak punya kehidupan sosial normal selain disuruh beli rokok untuk Adjutant Lentine.

column1: Then you're just ignorant. Last week I happened to see Kenny in the Green Zone commercial street, wandering around the entrance of a very exquisite jewelry store for over half an hour.
column2: Berarti kau kurang informasi. Minggu lalu aku kebetulan lihat Kenny di jalan komersial Green Zone, mondar-mandir di depan toko perhiasan yang sangat mewah lebih dari setengah jam.

column1: Oh~~~ an exquisite jewelry store~~~
column2: Oh~~~ toko perhiasan yang mewah~~~

column1: Quick, tell me, what good stuff did you buy?
column2: Cepat cerita, barang bagus apa yang kau beli?

column1: Ahem, do you guys really want to be complained about by the technical department again for disturbing the peace late at night?
column2: Ehem, kalian benar-benar mau diadukan lagi departemen teknik karena bikin gaduh tengah malam?

column1: Let's go, let's go! Otherwise this month's allowance will really be completely deducted by Miss Lisa.
column2: Ayo pergi, ayo! Kalau tidak tunjangan bulan ini benar-benar habis dipotong Miss Lisa.

column1: (The members of the Omen Squad filed out, winking and laughing. In the blink of an eye, only Lisa and Kenny were left in the originally noisy preparation room.)
column2: (Anggota Omen Squad berbaris keluar sambil main mata dan tertawa. Dalam sekejap, hanya Lisa dan Kenny yang tertinggal di ruang persiapan yang tadinya riuh.)

column1: Thank you for bailing me out, Lisa.
column2: Terima kasih sudah menyelamatkanku, Lisa.

column1: It's nothing, don't mind it.
column2: Bukan apa-apa, tidak perlu dipikirkan.

column1: Alright, hurry up and answer your call, don't make the little girl wait too long.
column2: Sudah, cepat jawab panggilanmu, jangan biarkan anak itu menunggu terlalu lama.

column1: Also, good luck.
column2: Dan, semoga berhasil.

column1: (Lisa tossed a communication terminal to Kenny and left the training room with a sly smile.)
column2: (Lisa melempar terminal komunikasi ke Kenny dan meninggalkan ruang latihan dengan senyum jenaka.)

column1: (After watching Lisa leave and closing the metal door, Kenny confirmed the encrypted source of the external communication and pressed the connect button.)
column2: (Setelah melihat Lisa pergi dan menutup pintu logamnya, Kenny memastikan sumber terenkripsi komunikasi luar itu lalu menekan tombol sambung.)

column1: (Beep-beep-beep.)
column2: (Bip-bip-bip.)

column1: (The communication was successfully connected, and an enthusiastic, crisp voice with the unique vitality of a young girl came from the other end.)
column2: (Komunikasi tersambung, dan suara ceria dan nyaring dengan semangat khas anak perempuan datang dari ujung sana.)

column1: Brother Kenny! Good evening~
column2: Kak Kenny! Selamat malam~

column1: Good evening, Nadiya.
column2: Selamat malam, Nadiya.

column1: Huh? Why isn't the camera on? Why can't I see your face, Brother... Ah! Are you using your Mangi Security internal secure line again?!
column2: Lho? Kenapa kameranya tidak nyala? Kenapa aku tidak bisa lihat wajah Kakak... Ah! Kakak pakai jalur aman internal Mangi Security lagi ya?!

column1: Brother, you should switch to the civilian line sometimes to video call me. I haven't seen your face in so long.
column2: Kak, kadang-kadang ganti ke jalur sipil dong buat video call aku. Sudah lama aku tidak lihat wajah Kakak.

column1: Hmph, you must be looking all scruffy with dark circles and stubble again, and that's why you don't dare let me see you, right?!
column2: Hmph, pasti Kakak kelihatan acak-acakan lagi dengan mata panda dan brewok, makanya tidak berani menampakkan diri, kan?!

column1: I... N-No I'm not.
column2: Aku... B-bukan begitu.

column1: You hesitated! You hesitated just now, I definitely guessed right!
column2: Kakak ragu! Tadi Kakak ragu, dugaanku pasti benar!

column1: Work has indeed been quite busy lately... We're about to go execute a very important mission.
column2: Pekerjaan memang cukup sibuk belakangan ini... Kami akan segera menjalankan misi yang sangat penting.

column1: So I've been living at the headquarters lately...
column2: Jadi belakangan ini aku tinggal di markas...

column1: That fast? I thought I could give you guys a longer vacation.
column2: Secepat itu? Kupikir aku bisa memberi kalian cuti yang lebih panjang.

column1: After mom and dad saw the news reports, they immediately came to ask me about your situation.
column2: Setelah Ayah dan Ibu lihat berita, mereka langsung datang menanyakan keadaan Kakak padaku.

column1: They asked me if you've been eating well, and if you've been taking good care of yourself.
column2: Mereka tanya apa Kakak makan dengan baik, dan apa Kakak menjaga diri dengan baik.

column1: And the most, most, most important point—asking if you have a girlfriend yet!
column2: Dan poin yang paling, paling, paling penting—apa Kakak sudah punya kekasih!

column1: Brother~ when exactly do you plan to officially bring Big Sis Lentine home to show Mom and Dad~
column2: Kak~ kapan sebenarnya Kakak berniat membawa Kak Lentine pulang secara resmi buat diperkenalkan ke Ayah dan Ibu~

column1: Uh... Nada.
column2: Eh... Nada.

column1: (Facing his family's inquiries, Kenny felt slightly embarrassed.)
column2: (Menghadapi pertanyaan keluarganya, Kenny agak salah tingkah.)

column1: Eh? No way, did Big Sis Lentine not agree... No! Looking at your reaction, Brother, could it be that you still haven't mustered the courage to confess to Big Sis Lentine until now!
column2: Eh? Jangan-jangan Kak Lentine tidak setuju... Bukan! Dari reaksi Kakak, jangan-jangan sampai sekarang Kakak belum berani menyatakan perasaan ke Kak Lentine!

column1: I... didn't find the chance.
column2: Aku... belum menemukan kesempatannya.

column1: Eh~~~ Brother, did you forget, Sister Lentine had a lot of people pursuing her back in military academy.
column2: Eh~~~ Kak, Kakak lupa ya, Kak Lentine dulu di akademi militer banyak yang mengejar-ngejar.

column1: If you don't make a move quickly, Sister Lentine will be snatched away by someone else.
column2: Kalau Kakak tidak cepat bergerak, Kak Lentine bakal disambar orang lain.

column1: Ah, if it really doesn't work out... Brother, you can marry into Sister Lentine's family~ I'll go help persuade Mom and Dad.
column2: Ah, kalau memang tidak berhasil... Kakak bisa ikut masuk ke keluarga Kak Lentine~ Aku yang akan membujuk Ayah dan Ibu.

column1: You're so young... where on earth did you learn all this messy stuff.
column2: Kau masih kecil... dari mana kau belajar hal-hal aneh begitu.

column1: Sister Lisa taught me.
column2: Kak Lisa yang mengajariku.

column1: Lisa... sigh...
column2: Lisa... haah...

column1: ...How are things at home recently?
column2: ...Bagaimana keadaan di rumah belakangan ini?

column1: Mom and Dad are both in good health. Since moving to the Green Zone, Dad's E.L.I.D. symptoms haven't worsened or flared up again.
column2: Ayah dan Ibu sehat-sehat. Sejak pindah ke Green Zone, gejala E.L.I.D. Ayah tidak memburuk atau kambuh lagi.

column1: Mom... misses you very much. She often asks me to persuade you to resign. She feels this job is still too dangerous... and this job doesn't even have holidays!
column2: Ibu... sangat merindukan Kakak. Dia sering menyuruhku membujuk Kakak berhenti kerja. Menurutnya pekerjaan ini terlalu berbahaya... dan pekerjaan ini bahkan tidak ada hari liburnya!

column1: ...I can't leave her right now.
column2: ...Aku tidak bisa meninggalkan dia sekarang.

column1: How are you? Have you been studying hard?
column2: Kau bagaimana? Belajarnya rajin?

column1: Hmph, all subjects were straight A's at the end of the term, ranked first in the grade~ I absolutely did not let down my brother's expectations and investment.
column2: Hmph, semua mata pelajaran A di akhir semester, peringkat satu seangkatan~ Aku sama sekali tidak mengecewakan harapan dan investasi Kakak.

column1: My mentor told me privately that as soon as I graduate, he will recommend me for an internship at a subsidiary under the FABN Group.
column2: Pembimbingku bilang diam-diam bahwa begitu aku lulus, dia akan merekomendasikanku magang di anak perusahaan FABN Group.

column1: Even... if you're lucky, getting the qualification to intern at 16Lab is not impossible!
column2: Bahkan... kalau beruntung, dapat kualifikasi magang di 16Lab bukan hal mustahil!

column1: Is that so...
column2: Begitu ya...

column1: Brother, you've been preparing for so long, aren't you going to confess to Sister Lentine yet?
column2: Kak, Kakak sudah menyiapkannya begitu lama, belum mau menyatakan perasaan ke Kak Lentine?

column1: Actually, sometimes I think Mom is right. You could actually come back with Sister Lentine...
column2: Sebenarnya kadang aku merasa Ibu benar. Kakak bisa saja pulang bersama Kak Lentine...

column1: (Hearing his sister's pleading voice, Kenny was silent for a while, and finally sighed.)
column2: (Mendengar suara adiknya yang memohon, Kenny terdiam beberapa saat, lalu akhirnya mengembuskan napas.)

column1: ...After this mission is over, I will bring Lentine home together.
column2: ...Setelah misi ini selesai, aku akan membawa Lentine pulang bersamaku.

column1: Really! Yay~
column2: Serius! Yeay~

column1: Then can I immediately start practicing changing my tune and calling Sister Lentine "Sister-in-law" in advance~
column2: Kalau begitu aku boleh mulai latihan ganti panggilan dan menyebut Kak Lentine "Kakak Ipar" dari sekarang~

column1: This... is a bit early, right.
column2: Ini... agak terlalu cepat, ya.

column1: If, this time I fail to fulfill the agreement. Don't blame Lentine... she...
column2: Kalau, kali ini aku gagal menepati janji itu. Jangan salahkan Lentine... dia...

column1: Brother? What nonsense are you talking about? What happened? Why are you suddenly saying such ominous things.
column2: Kak? Kakak bicara apa sih? Ada apa? Kenapa tiba-tiba mengatakan hal yang tidak enak begitu.

column1: No... it's nothing, I'm fine. I just... want to give Lentine a surprise tonight.
column2: Tidak... bukan apa-apa, aku baik-baik saja. Aku cuma... mau memberi Lentine kejutan malam ini.

column1: I'm a little unsure in my heart, hahahaha.
column2: Hatiku agak tidak yakin, hahahaha.

column1: (Kenny forced out a somewhat stiff laugh, trying to soothe his sensitive sister on the other end of the terminal with as calm a tone as possible.)
column2: (Kenny memaksakan tawa yang agak kaku, berusaha menenangkan adiknya yang sensitif di ujung terminal dengan nada setenang mungkin.)

column1: Brother will definitely be fine! Have confidence! Besides, you've been with Sister Lentine for so long!
column2: Kakak pasti berhasil! Percaya diri dong! Lagi pula Kakak sudah bersama Kak Lentine selama itu!

column1: There will definitely be no problem! Definitely!
column2: Pasti tidak akan ada masalah! Pasti!

column1: Haha, hearing you say that gives me a bit of confidence too.
column2: Haha, mendengarmu bilang begitu aku jadi sedikit percaya diri juga.

column1: Then I'll go prepare. You should rest early after finishing your homework too.
column2: Aku pergi bersiap kalau begitu. Kau juga cepat tidur setelah selesai PR.

column1: Mhm, good night~ Brother~
column2: Mhm, selamat malam~ Kak~

column1: (Hanging up the communication, Kenny took out the small box he had ordered a long time ago and only went to retrieve today from the inner pocket of his combat suit.)
column2: (Setelah menutup komunikasi, Kenny mengeluarkan kotak kecil yang sudah lama dia pesan dan baru dia ambil hari ini dari kantong dalam seragam tempurnya.)

column1: (A black velvet case smaller than a palm, with a burgundy satin lining. Lying quietly inside were matching rings made of special precious metal, engraved with a griffin pattern.)
column2: (Kotak beludru hitam yang lebih kecil dari telapak tangan, dengan pelapis satin merah tua. Di dalamnya tergeletak tenang sepasang cincin dari logam mulia khusus, berukir motif griffin.)

column1: (Kenny took a deep breath, clenched the box tightly in his hand, and strode out of the preparation room.)
column2: (Kenny menarik napas panjang, menggenggam kotak itu erat-erat, dan melangkah lebar keluar ruang persiapan.)

column1: (Green Zone, outside the Mangi Security situation room.)
column2: (Green Zone, di luar ruang situasi Mangi Security.)

column1: (The shrewd and capable logistics officer Lisa was pacing back and forth at the door of the command room holding a stack of documents. The moment she saw Kenny approaching, she sighed helplessly and shook her head vigorously.)
column2: (Lisa, petugas logistik yang cerdas dan cekatan, mondar-mandir di depan pintu ruang komando sambil memegang setumpuk dokumen. Begitu melihat Kenny mendekat, dia mengembuskan napas tak berdaya dan menggeleng keras.)

column1: I say, our honorable Captain Kenny, it's been a full ten minutes since you hung up the communication with Nadiya until you dawdled over here... I thought you, this piece of thousand-year-old dead wood, finally got it and went to take a shower and change into clean, decent clothes.
column2: Begini ya, Kapten Kenny yang terhormat, sudah sepuluh menit penuh sejak kau menutup komunikasi dengan Nadiya sampai kau berjalan lambat-lambat ke sini... Kupikir kayu mati berumur seribu tahun ini akhirnya paham dan pergi mandi lalu ganti pakaian yang bersih dan layak.

column1: But you actually still came here covered in this stinking sweat! Do you even know what you're here for tonight!
column2: Tapi kau malah datang ke sini dengan keringat bau seperti ini! Kau tahu untuk apa kau ada di sini malam ini!

column1: Uh... is it that important?
column2: Eh... apa itu sepenting itu?

column1: Very important!
column2: Sangat penting!

column1: Do you know how stomach-aching it is for us bystanders to watch the ambiguous and completely unprogressing relationship between you two every day?
column2: Kau tahu betapa sakit perutnya kami yang menonton dari samping melihat hubungan kalian yang serba samar dan sama sekali tidak maju-maju setiap hari?

column1: Let me guess, what's in that box you're carefully holding right now... probably isn't the ring I helped you pick out either, right.
column2: Coba kutebak, isi kotak yang kau pegang hati-hati itu... kemungkinan bukan cincin yang kubantu pilihkan juga, kan.

column1: How'd you know?
column2: Bagaimana kau tahu?

column1: Because you didn't listen to my advice either, to pick a time when Adjutant Lentine is in a good mood, tidy up your hair, change into nice clothes, and then confess with full confidence.
column2: Karena saranku juga tidak kau turuti, memilih waktu saat Adjutant Lentine sedang senang, merapikan rambut, ganti pakaian bagus, lalu menyatakan perasaan dengan percaya diri penuh.

column1: The way you look... if Adjutant Lentine were a normal girl, she would definitely be angry.
column2: Dengan penampilanmu itu... kalau Adjutant Lentine perempuan biasa, dia sudah pasti marah.

column1: (Lisa shot Kenny an exasperated glare.)
column2: (Lisa melempar tatapan gemas ke Kenny.)

column1: What is she doing now?
column2: Dia sedang apa sekarang?

column1: I have some bad news for you. Just 30 minutes ago, your dear adjutant Lentine reviewed the riddled embezzlement ledger of the troops Lonnie previously managed, as well as the evaluation report on the severe lack of training in the logistics troops, plus the absurdly high military budget report for this operation...
column2: Ada kabar buruk untukmu. Baru 30 menit lalu, adjutant Lentine tersayangmu memeriksa buku besar penggelapan yang bolong-bolong dari pasukan yang dulu dikelola Lonnie, ditambah laporan evaluasi soal pasukan logistik yang parah kurang latihan, plus laporan anggaran militer operasi ini yang tingginya tidak masuk akal...

column1: In a fit of rage, she kicked everyone out and locked herself alone in the combat intelligence room.
column2: Dalam kemarahan besar, dia mengusir semua orang dan mengunci dirinya sendiri di ruang intelijen tempur.

column1: Without you as a stabilizer, she's simply like a highly flammable and explosive oil barrel. I don't want to go touch her bad luck.
column2: Tanpa kau sebagai penstabil, dia benar-benar seperti tong minyak yang mudah terbakar dan meledak. Aku tidak mau kena sialnya.

column1: Oh right, and the matter with Roberti, sigh... we have too many things we can't let that little one know. But we lack capable and trustworthy people.
column2: Oh iya, dan soal Roberti, haah... terlalu banyak hal yang tidak boleh diketahui anak itu. Tapi kita kekurangan orang yang cakap dan bisa dipercaya.

column1: She is very important to Lentine. Keep her away from the front line as much as possible.
column2: Dia sangat penting untuk Lentine. Jauhkan dia dari garis depan sebisa mungkin.

column1: I know that.
column2: Aku tahu itu.

column1: (Lisa stepped forward, took a clean handkerchief from her pocket, and with a hint of disgust, haphazardly wiped the sweat seeping from Kenny's forehead, then reached out to smooth his messy hair a bit.)
column2: (Lisa melangkah maju, mengambil sapu tangan bersih dari kantongnya, dan dengan sedikit rasa jijik mengusap sekenanya keringat yang merembes di dahi Kenny, lalu mengulurkan tangan merapikan sedikit rambutnya yang acak-acakan.)

column1: But for Adjutant Lentine right now, what she needs most is you, the tranquilizer to soothe her anxiety.
column2: Tapi untuk Adjutant Lentine sekarang, yang paling dia butuhkan adalah kau, penenang yang meredakan kegelisahannya.

column1: I'll leave it to you. I have to go back to the logistics department to inventory the newly arrived supplies.
column2: Kuserahkan padamu. Aku harus balik ke departemen logistik untuk mendata pasokan yang baru datang.

column1: (Lisa made a mischievous face at Kenny, then waved her hand dashingly, leaving this empty corridor and tightly closed door to Kenny.)
column2: (Lisa membuat wajah jahil ke Kenny, lalu melambaikan tangan dengan gaya, meninggalkan koridor kosong dan pintu yang tertutup rapat itu untuk Kenny.)

column1: (Kenny helplessly let out a hint of an exhausted smile. He took a deep breath of the air mixed with the scent of disinfectant, reached out, and pushed open the heavy door to the Combat Intelligence Room.)
column2: (Kenny tak berdaya melepas sedikit senyum lelah. Dia menarik napas panjang dari udara yang bercampur bau disinfektan, mengulurkan tangan, dan mendorong pintu berat ruang intelijen tempur.)

column1: (The Combat Intelligence Room of Omen Squad was Lentine's absolute restricted zone. Even within Omen Squad, no one apart from Kenny and Lisa had the clearance to step half a foot inside.)
column2: (Ruang Intelijen Tempur Omen Squad adalah wilayah terlarang mutlak milik Lentine. Bahkan di dalam Omen Squad, selain Kenny dan Lisa tidak ada yang punya izin menjejakkan setengah kaki ke dalam.)

column1: (The main light source in the room had been intentionally dimmed, and the air was permeated with the pungent, choking smell of burning cheap tobacco. In the corners of the room, discarded tactical documents crumpled into balls piled up haphazardly like small mountains.)
column2: (Sumber cahaya utama di ruangan itu sengaja diredupkan, dan udaranya dipenuhi bau menyengat dan menyesakkan tembakau murahan yang dibakar. Di sudut-sudut ruangan, dokumen taktis yang dibuang dan digulung jadi bola menumpuk sembarangan seperti gunung-gunung kecil.)

column1: (The only area that remained absolutely pristine was the virtual holographic sand table emitting a faint blue light in the center of the room. The sand table was densely marked with the tactical simulations Lentine had mapped out to deal with various contingencies.)
column2: (Satu-satunya area yang tetap benar-benar bersih adalah meja pasir holografis virtual yang memancarkan cahaya biru samar di tengah ruangan. Meja pasir itu penuh tanda simulasi taktis yang disusun Lentine untuk menghadapi berbagai kemungkinan.)

column1: (Kenny looked around and, piercing through the dim light, quickly located Lentine.)
column2: (Kenny memandang sekeliling dan, menembus cahaya yang redup, cepat menemukan Lentine.)

column1: (At this moment, she resembled a small animal that had exhausted all its stamina, curled up on the leather sofa in the corner, her breathing slightly tired but steady.)
column2: (Saat itu dia menyerupai binatang kecil yang sudah menghabiskan seluruh tenaganya, meringkuk di sofa kulit di sudut ruangan, napasnya agak lelah tapi teratur.)

column1: (Kenny softened his footsteps and walked to her side, kneeling on one knee. He gently untied and removed her tactical boots, then picked up a wool blanket from the side and carefully draped it over her.)
column2: (Kenny melembutkan langkahnya dan berjalan ke sisinya, lalu berlutut satu kaki. Dia melepas ikatan dan menanggalkan bot taktisnya dengan lembut, lalu mengambil selimut wol di samping dan menyelimutinya hati-hati.)

column1: (Kenny reached out, wanting to smooth out the slight frown she wore even in her sleep, but paused mid-air. His fingertips trembled slightly before he slowly lowered his hand.)
column2: (Kenny mengulurkan tangan, ingin meluruskan kerutan kecil yang tetap dia pakai bahkan dalam tidur, tapi berhenti di udara. Ujung jarinya bergetar sedikit sebelum dia perlahan menurunkan tangannya.)

column1: You're still the same as before...
column2: Kau masih sama seperti dulu...

column1: Hello, I'm Lentine. You're Kenny, who got second place in this tactical sandbox simulation test, right? Good job, your tactical vision is much more interesting than those slow classmates who only know how to memorize dogma.
column2: Hai, aku Lentine. Kau Kenny yang dapat peringkat dua di tes simulasi kotak pasir taktis ini, kan? Kerja bagus, visi taktismu jauh lebih menarik dibanding teman-teman lamban yang cuma tahu menghafal dogma.

column1: By the way, for the next joint tactical simulation training... are you interested in teaming up with me? If you help me plan the tactical details together, I think we can definitely break the highest score record for this test.
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, untuk latihan simulasi taktis gabungan berikutnya... kau tertarik satu tim denganku? Kalau kau membantuku menyusun detail taktisnya, kurasa kita pasti bisa memecahkan rekor skor tertinggi tes ini.

column1: Kenny, do you know {}? The... legendary graduate whose grades were all the most outstanding.
column2: Kenny, kau tahu {}? Lulusan... legendaris yang semua nilainya paling menonjol.

column1: I heard that person went to a P.M.C. to be a Commander. What a pity, I originally wanted to spar with him.
column2: Kudengar orang itu masuk ke sebuah P.M.C. jadi Commander. Sayang sekali, aku sebenarnya ingin bertanding dengannya.

column1: Kenny, are you interested in breaking all of that person's records together with me!
column2: Kenny, kau tertarik memecahkan semua rekor orang itu bersamaku!

column1: ...Kenny, I'll figure something out. I won't just watch the brothers and sisters who follow us lose their home.
column2: ...Kenny, aku akan mencari jalan. Aku tidak akan diam saja melihat saudara-saudara yang mengikuti kita kehilangan rumah mereka.

column1: I will bear the responsibility of a commander... I will give you, and everyone, an explanation.
column2: Aku akan menanggung tanggung jawab seorang komandan... Aku akan memberi kau, dan semuanya, penjelasan.

column1: Even if... even if I don't become a hero, I will definitely give you a way to survive in this world.
column2: Bahkan kalau... bahkan kalau aku tidak jadi pahlawan, aku pasti akan memberi kalian jalan untuk bertahan hidup di dunia ini.

column1: (By the time Kenny snapped out of his long memories, he had silently cleaned up the messy combat intelligence room. But he didn't go and wake the still-sleeping Lentine as originally planned.)
column2: (Saat Kenny tersadar dari ingatan panjangnya, dia sudah membersihkan ruang intelijen tempur yang berantakan itu tanpa suara. Tapi dia tidak membangunkan Lentine yang masih tertidur seperti rencana awalnya.)

column1: (He took the delicate small black box out of his pocket and gently opened it. Under the dim light, the pair of plain griffin relief rings lay quietly on the red satin.)
column2: (Dia mengeluarkan kotak hitam kecil yang halus itu dari kantongnya dan membukanya lembut. Di bawah cahaya redup, sepasang cincin berelief griffin yang sederhana itu tergeletak tenang di atas satin merah.)

column1: (He had stopped at various jewelry stores many times, racking his brains to get Lentine's accurate ring finger size. He had rehearsed in his mind countless times how Lentine would react upon seeing it. Ultimately, he followed his heart and chose this pair—rings that represented their first meeting and the starting point of their ideals.)
column2: (Dia sudah berhenti di berbagai toko perhiasan berkali-kali, memeras otak demi mendapatkan ukuran jari manis Lentine yang tepat. Dia sudah membayangkan berkali-kali reaksi Lentine saat melihatnya. Akhirnya dia mengikuti kata hatinya dan memilih sepasang ini—cincin yang mewakili pertemuan pertama mereka dan titik awal cita-cita mereka.)

column1: (Kenny took a deep breath, and just as he had practiced countless times in empty places to the air, he knelt on one knee before the sleeping Lentine.)
column2: (Kenny menarik napas panjang, dan seperti yang sudah dia latih berkali-kali di tempat kosong kepada udara, dia berlutut satu kaki di depan Lentine yang tertidur.)

column1: Lentine... I like you. I've been deeply attracted to you ever since we first met.
column2: Lentine... aku menyukaimu. Aku tertarik padamu sedalam ini sejak pertemuan pertama kita.

column1: From our first meeting to the day we graduated, from joining Griffin to the day Griffin disbanded, from joining Mangi Security up until now... I've missed countless opportunities to speak up out of cowardice and hesitation.
column2: Dari pertemuan pertama sampai hari kita lulus, dari masuk Griffin sampai hari Griffin bubar, dari masuk Mangi Security sampai sekarang... aku melewatkan kesempatan bicara yang tak terhitung karena pengecut dan ragu.

column1: Actually, I really want to leave all this behind and say to you... let's go, let's leave this hellhole together.
column2: Sebenarnya aku sangat ingin meninggalkan semua ini dan berkata padamu... ayo pergi, mari tinggalkan lubang neraka ini bersama.

column1: Leave this... quagmire that only treats you as a handy, mindless killing blade. Mangi Security is not our only chance... as long as we are alive, there are still many choices.
column2: Tinggalkan... rawa yang cuma memperlakukanmu sebagai bilah pembunuh yang praktis dan tanpa pikiran. Mangi Security bukan satu-satunya peluang kita... selama kita hidup, masih banyak pilihan.

column1: But I know you won't stop. The dreams of those dead brothers, the oaths we once swore, and your damn obsession with that person...
column2: Tapi aku tahu kau tidak akan berhenti. Mimpi saudara-saudara yang sudah mati, ikrar yang pernah kita ucapkan, dan obsesi sialanmu pada orang itu...

column1: So I... I absolutely cannot selfishly become the resistance dragging your footsteps at this time.
column2: Jadi aku... aku sama sekali tidak boleh egois menjadi hambatan yang menarik langkahmu di saat seperti ini.

column1: (A trace of determination flashed in Kenny's eyes. He silently closed the lid and stuffed the box containing the couple rings back into his inner pocket. Then, he reached out and gently covered Lentine's somewhat cold back of the hand with his palm.)
column2: (Segaris tekad berkilat di mata Kenny. Tanpa suara dia menutup tutupnya dan menyusupkan kembali kotak berisi cincin pasangan itu ke kantong dalamnya. Lalu dia mengulurkan tangan dan lembut menutupi punggung tangan Lentine yang agak dingin dengan telapaknya.)

column1: If you have truly made up your mind, even if it means sacrificing everything you have, even your life, to climb to that peak where you can control your destiny.
column2: Kalau kau memang sudah memantapkan hati, bahkan jika itu berarti mengorbankan semua yang kau punya, sampai nyawamu, demi mendaki ke puncak tempat kau bisa mengendalikan takdirmu sendiri.

column1: Then, I will jump into the abyss one step ahead of you, using my flesh and blood to pave the road beneath your feet. Even if... my body is smashed to pieces and I am doomed eternally.
column2: Maka, aku akan melompat ke jurang satu langkah di depanmu, memakai tubuh dan darahku untuk mengaspal jalan di bawah kakimu. Bahkan jika... tubuhku hancur berkeping-keping dan aku terkutuk selamanya.

column1: Whether hell or purgatory lies ahead, I am willing to walk with you.
column2: Neraka atau api penyucian yang ada di depan, aku bersedia berjalan bersamamu.

column1: If... I mean if there really comes a day when I fall before you... please do not feel sad for me, and definitely do not turn back for me. Because only then will you have a chance to cross that abyss that devours everything.
column2: Kalau... maksudku kalau benar-benar datang hari saat aku tumbang lebih dulu darimu... tolong jangan bersedih untukku, dan sama sekali jangan berbalik untukku. Karena hanya dengan begitu kau punya peluang menyeberangi jurang yang menelan segalanya itu.

column1: Live well, Lentine. As long as you are alive. Yes, as long as you are alive, that is enough.
column2: Hiduplah baik-baik, Lentine. Selama kau hidup. Ya, selama kau hidup, itu sudah cukup.

column1: Heh... who am I kidding. Actually, what I really want to say is... please, don't forget...
column2: Heh... siapa yang kubohongi. Sebenarnya yang benar-benar ingin kukatakan adalah... kumohon, jangan lupakan...

column1: No, nothing at all.
column2: Tidak, bukan apa-apa.

column1: (In front of the sleeping Lentine, Kenny ultimately didn't have the courage to carry out his insignificant willful intention. Looking at her sleeping face, which was still tense even in her dreams, he couldn't selfishly impose this heavy love on her at this time.)
column2: (Di depan Lentine yang tertidur, Kenny akhirnya tidak punya keberanian menjalankan niat kecilnya yang egois itu. Menatap wajah tidurnya yang tetap tegang bahkan di dalam mimpi, dia tidak bisa dengan egois menimpakan cinta seberat itu padanya saat ini.)

column1: (At least in the current situation, they still need this fragile superior-subordinate relationship to maintain balance between them.)
column2: (Setidaknya dalam situasi sekarang, mereka masih butuh hubungan atasan-bawahan yang rapuh ini untuk menjaga keseimbangan di antara mereka.)

column1: (But ultimately, he couldn't bear to throw away the box containing all his sincerity, but kept it close to his heart.)
column2: (Tapi akhirnya dia tidak sanggup membuang kotak yang menyimpan seluruh ketulusannya itu, dan menyimpannya dekat dengan hatinya.)

column1: ...Kenny? How long have I been asleep?
column2: ...Kenny? Berapa lama aku tertidur?

column1: 10 minutes since I came in. We still have time.
column2: 10 menit sejak aku masuk. Kita masih punya waktu.

column1: Time? Right, I remember now.
column2: Waktu? Benar, sekarang aku ingat.

column1: Here, help me recalculate the time it takes for the logistics troops to depart from Turul. I need to readjust the marching pace of the logistics and frontline troops.
column2: Ini, bantu aku menghitung ulang waktu yang dibutuhkan pasukan logistik untuk berangkat dari Turul. Aku perlu menyetel ulang tempo gerak pasukan logistik dan garis depan.

column1: Also, help me reassess the combat personnel quality of those trash under Lonnie's command. Alright, what are you spacing out for, standing there like an idiot! Come here and work!
column2: Bantu aku juga menilai ulang kualitas personel tempur sampah-sampah di bawah komando Lonnie. Sudah, kenapa bengong, berdiri di situ seperti orang bodoh! Ke sini dan kerja!

column1: (Lentine suddenly sat up and slapped Kenny heavily on the shoulder. This sudden force made Kenny, who was immersed in his thoughts, go weak in the knees and almost kneel directly on the ground.)
column2: (Lentine tiba-tiba duduk tegak dan menepuk keras bahu Kenny. Dorongan mendadak itu membuat Kenny yang tenggelam dalam pikirannya lemas di lutut dan hampir langsung bersimpuh ke lantai.)

column1: When did you become so fragile?
column2: Sejak kapan kau jadi serapuh ini?

column1: Ah, ah? Ah no... did you hear something...
column2: Ah, ah? Ah tidak... kau mendengar sesuatu...

column1: What? Don't be stupid, Kenny.
column2: Apa? Jangan bodoh, Kenny.

column1: And I've said it many times, this blanket is very hot! Every time I just fall asleep, I get woken up by the heat... It's really annoying. Don't just stand there, hurry up and make coffee, we still have a lot of things to handle.
column2: Dan sudah berkali-kali kubilang, selimut ini panas sekali! Setiap kali baru tertidur, aku terbangun karena kepanasan... Benar-benar menjengkelkan. Jangan cuma berdiri di situ, cepat buat kopi, masih banyak yang harus kita tangani.

column1: ...Who is it...
column2: ...Siapa itu...

column1: Kenny! Kenny! Hold on!
column2: Kenny! Kenny! Bertahanlah!

column1: My body... can't feel pain anymore...
column2: Tubuhku... sudah tidak bisa merasakan sakit...

column1: Commander Lentine, he has already...
column2: Commander Lentine, dia sudah...

column1: <size=28>Shut up! All of you shut up!</size>
column2: <size=28>Diam! Kalian semua diam!</size>

column1: Kenny, hold on, there must be a way...
column2: Kenny, bertahanlah, pasti ada caranya...

column1: Ah... you're okay...
column2: Ah... kau baik-baik saja...

column1: That's great... as long as you're okay...
column2: Bagus... selama kau baik-baik saja...

column1: Don't close your eyes! Look at me! Kenny!
column2: Jangan tutup matamu! Lihat aku! Kenny!

column1: You still have something to say to me! Right!
column2: Kau masih punya sesuatu untuk kau katakan padaku! Kan!

column1: Don't forget Nadiya! And your family!
column2: Jangan lupakan Nadiya! Dan keluargamu!

column1: You...
column2: Kau...

column1: Sorry...
column2: Maaf...

column1: ...The words from that night...
column2: ...Kata-kata malam itu...

column1: ...I ultimately didn't say them out loud...
column2: ...akhirnya tidak pernah kuucapkan...

column1: ...That's really great...
column2: ...Itu justru bagus...

column1: I see...
column2: Begitu ya...

column1: My death... won't become the shackle that drags you into the abyss...
column2: Kematianku... tidak akan menjadi belenggu yang menarikmu ke dalam jurang...

column1: ...This way, you can without any scruples...
column2: ...Dengan begini, kau bisa tanpa beban...

column1: ...continue... moving forward...
column2: ...terus... melangkah maju...
